BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Construction Plant, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Plant.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Plant.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Construction Plant.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.

2. When learning Construction Hand Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Hand Power Tools.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

4. When learning Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Windows.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Windows.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Windows.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

6. When learning Sanitary Appliances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Sanitary Appliances.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Sanitary Appliances.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Sanitary Appliances.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Sanitary Appliances.

7. When learning Appropriate Technology in Building, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Appropriate Technology in Building.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Appropriate Technology in Building.

8. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

10. When learning Roof Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Roof Construction.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Roof Construction.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Roof Construction.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Roof Construction.

11. When learning Domestic Water Supply, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Domestic Water Supply.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Domestic Water Supply.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Domestic Water Supply.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Domestic Water Supply.

12. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Domestic Water Supply and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Sanitary Appliances and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Drainage Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Building Construction Project and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.

8. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
